QUOTE: `library/common.h:132` | Unconditionally `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`. Library `.c` files include `common.h` first (e.g. `ecdh.c:15`, `md.c:12`, `x509_crt.c:20`), so their struct accesses use the real member names.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the shared header library/common.h defines the opt-out, so library translation units that include it see plain member names.
